# Kautusan Bayan sa Laang Gugulin No. 01, Series of 2002

**Appropriation Ordinance for the 2003 Annual Budget**

## Summary

This ordinance approves the appropriation of P25,018,790.63 for the 2003 annual budget of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It details the allocation of funds for various expenditures and is based on the recommendation of the Committee on Finance, Budget & Appropriation. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] on December 16, [[2002]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates funds from the total estimated revenues, including the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA), amounting to P-4,547,686.18 and other local income amounting to P-20,471,104.45, totaling P-25,018,790.63 for the 2003 budget.
2.  **Section 2.** Stipulates that the budget includes a 70% increase in Representation and Transportation Allowance (RATA) and 30 days monetization of leave credits.
3.  **Section 3.** States that the 2003 annual budget for the Office of the Mayor is detailed in Annex "A".
4.  **Section 4.** States that [[Kautusang Bayan sa Laang Gugulin]] Blg. 01 takes effect on January 1, [[2003]].
5.  **Section 5.** Approves the ordinance on December 16, [[2002]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
